payload.body: You tend to know how to read the room, keep the peace, or handle a difficult person without losing track of what you want. Familiar competence supports honesty instead of replacing it. You usually understand which old skills still serve you and which ones were only ways to stay acceptable. This makes it easier to use experience without automatically repeating the past.
